ruleDefinitions.name: Password Reset By User Account
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect when a user has reset their password in Azure AD Note: Unmapped fields: Category, Status, Initiatedby, Target, ActivityType

sequences.query: (Category = "UserManagement" AND Status = "Success" AND Initiatedby = "UPN") AND (Target = RGX(".*UPN.*") AND ActivityType = RGX(".*Password\\ reset.*"))
